description: Test code for the HeadersPayloadDecoder in HTTP/2 frame decoding, including unit tests for payload parsing, padding, and priority flags.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderPeer
classes.description: Provides static methods related to the HEADERS frame type and its flags.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: Implements callback methods for handling various parts of the headers frame during decoding, used in testing.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing HeadersPayloadDecoder with different payload sizes and conditions.

methods.name: OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Called when headers decoding starts; records the frame header.

methods.name: OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Called when headers priority info is received.

methods.name: OnHpackFragment
methods.description: Called when an HPACK fragment is received.

methods.name: OnPadLength
methods.description: Called when pad length is specified.

methods.name: OnPadding
methods.description: Called when padding data is received.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Called when padding exceeds frame length.

methods.name: OnFrameSizeError
methods.description: Called when a frame size error occurs.
